reasoning_content:
The seed creates questions before votation types. Now validation requires votation_type present. Need to create votation_type before saving question. Let me modify the questions seed to build votation_type.

Let me patch the "Creating Poll Questions & Answers" section: create votation_type first. Then remove the later section or keep it (it uses create_votation_type! which would create a second). Better to integrate.

Let me view lines 60-95 and rewrite.

action.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/polls.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''      question = Poll::Question.new(author: User.all.sample,
                                    title: question_title,
                                    poll: poll)
      I18n.available_locales.map do |locale|
        Globalize.with_locale(locale) do
          question.title = "#{question_title} (#{locale})"
        end
      end
      question.save!'''
new='''      question = Poll::Question.new(author: User.all.sample,
                                    title: question_title,
                                    poll: poll)
      vote_type = VotationType.vote_types.keys.sample
      question.build_votation_type(vote_type: vote_type,
                                   max_votes: (3 unless vote_type == "unique"))
      I18n.available_locales.map do |locale|
        Globalize.with_locale(locale) do
          question.title = "#{question_title} (#{locale})"
        end
      end
      question.save!'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old2='''section "Creating Poll Votation types" do
  poll = Poll.first

  poll.questions.each do |question|
    vote_type = VotationType.vote_types.keys.sample
    question.create_votation_type!(vote_type: vote_type, max_votes: (3 unless vote_type == "unique"))
  end
end

'''
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,"",1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
sed -n '60,95p' db/dev_seeds/polls.rb
